name: Barbosania
sum: Crestless ornithocheiriform (targaryendraconian) from the Romualdo Formation of Brazil.
holotype: MNHS/00/85 — Romualdo Formation, Santana Group, NE Brazil (Museu de História Natural de Sintra).
material: Almost complete, partially articulated and uncompressed skeleton with skull (392 mm).
biology: Very long front teeth formed a rosette for catching slippery prey such as fish or squid.
author: Elgin and Frey 2011
